name: SettingsRow
title: SettingsRow
summary: Grouped inset settings for ISM apps: section headers, inset cards of 52px rows with toggles, values with ›, radio choices, a separate Sign out card and helper text.
whenToUse: Use on Settings and preference screens in dot.Bible and other ISM apps.
Use a toggle row for an on/off setting that applies at once.
Use a value row with › when the choice opens another screen (Language, Translation).
Use radio rows for picking one of two to five options in place (Default Bible).
whenNotToUse: Do not use these rows for content lists such as search results or episodes; use SearchResults or ListRow.

anatomy.description: Header `.ap-grp-h` above an inset card `.ap-grp` of `.ap-row`s, optional footer `.ap-grp-f`.

props.name: kind
props.description: `action` acts at once, `value` shows a value and › and opens another screen, `toggle` is an on/off switch, `radio` picks one option in place.

props.name: label
props.description: Short noun label, e.g. "Language".

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Second line (two-line row, 64px), e.g. "Needs Wi‑Fi".

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading 30px icon tile (use on every row of a card or none), e.g. `<UiIcon name="language" />`.

props.name: value
props.description: `value` rows: the current value, short, matching the next screen's selected option.

props.name: checked
props.description: `toggle` and `radio` rows: on / selected state (controlled).

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: `toggle` and `radio` rows: called with the next state. Toggles take effect at once; never pair with Save.

props.name: destructive
props.description: `action` rows: render in `--error`, alone in a `gap` group (Sign out).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dim the row and ignore input. Say why in `subtitle`.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler for `action` and `value` rows.

props.name: type
props.description: What the row does: `value` drills into another screen (value and chevron), `toggle` is an on/off switch, `radio` picks one in place, `action` acts at once with no trailing icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Short noun: "Language", "Verse numbers".

props.name: sublabel
props.description: Second line, which makes the row 64dp tall.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon in a 30dp blue-tint tile. Use on every row in a card or on none.

props.name: value
props.description: `value` rows: the current choice, short, matching the next screen's selected option.

props.name: checked
props.description: `toggle` rows: on or off. `radio` rows: this option is selected.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called when a toggle changes (with the new value) or a radio row is chosen. Toggles take effect at once; never pair with Save.

props.name: onPress
props.description: `value` and `action` rows: called on press.

props.name: danger
props.description: Destructive row such as Sign out: `error` colour, 600 weight, alone in its own group.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Says why a disabled row is unavailable ("Needs Wi‑Fi"); shown as the second line and read as the hint.

props.name: divider
props.description: Draw the hairline above this row, starting 16dp in. `SettingsGroup` sets it after the first row.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Cards inset 16px, `--radius-md`, white with a `--gray-200` hairline; dividers start 16px in.
Rows are at least 52px; two-line rows 64px (`.ap-row-tall`).
Leading icon tiles `.ap-ri` are 30px, `--blue-tint` with Horizon Blue icons. Use them on every row in a card or on none.
› means the row drills into another app screen. Never use › on a toggle or radio row; never use ↗ inside settings unless the row leaves the app.
Values are `--gray-600`, short, and match the next screen's selected option.
Section headers: 12/600 caps, `--overline-tracking`, `--gray-600`. Footers: 13px `--gray-600`, under the card.
Sign out sits alone at the end in `--error`. No confirmation colour elsewhere.
Toggles take effect immediately; never pair them with a Save button.

accessibility: Toggles are `role="switch"` with `aria-checked` and a label via `aria-labelledby`.
Radio groups use `role="radiogroup"` with a label; arrow keys move the selection.
Value rows announce both parts: "Language, English, button".
Disabled rows keep their text readable and say why ("Needs Wi‑Fi").
Focus ring: 2px Horizon Blue, inset on rows.
content: Labels are short nouns: "Language", "Verse numbers", "Wi‑Fi only", "Daily verse reminder".
Footers explain consequences in one sentence: "Downloaded Bibles work offline and stay on this phone after you sign out."
Translation names in full plus abbreviation: "Berean Standard Bible BSB".
